svg.title: How a document travels
svg.desc: Seven stages. Clean, overlap and dedup are TSAI jobs that the runner adopts or runs; apply, f2 and survivor loss are always run by run_pipeline.py; shards is optional. Duplicates leave at apply, benchmark copies at f2, the rest is the final Parquet, which shards turns into token shards.
svg.text: each stage must account for every
document it was given, or the run stops
